items.criterion: default behaviour unchanged when no apk-source.json
PUT /api/admin/app/source accepts github repo URL, releases api URL, direct https .apk; rejects http/private/local
POST /api/admin/app/upload stores valid .apk, rejects non-APK, mode=upload not overwritten by sync
admin.html shows source, URL input, reset, upload

other_issues: SSRF guard misses ::ffff:127.0.0.1, integer/hex IP literals, DNS-rebinding hosts; resolves loopback/private and bypasses safeUrl
PK-prefixed file under 1000 bytes passes route check then throws non-HttpError in saveUploadedApk -> 500 not 415
Upload UI shows toast only, no real progress bar (spec 'progress/toast'; toast present)

risky_spots.why: safeUrl/privateIp omit IPv4-in-IPv6 and dotted-decimal/hex IP forms
saveUploadedApk size<1000 path throws generic Error -> 500
upload handler has toast but no progress indicator
